mapper.sql: id, goods_id, `day`, score, reasons, status, execute_on, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_retire_candidate (goods_id, `day`, score, reasons, status, execute_on, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{goodsId}, #{day}, coalesce(#{score}, 0.00), #{reasons}, coalesce(#{status}, 'proposed'), #{executeOn}, now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update score = if(status = 'proposed', values(score), score), reasons = if(status = 'proposed', values(reasons), reasons), update_time = if(status = 'proposed', now(), update_time)
mapper.select: select from litemall_retire_candidate where `day` = #{day} and deleted = 0 and status = #{status} order by score desc, id asc
select from litemall_retire_candidate where status = #{status} and deleted = 0 order by `day` desc, score desc, id asc limit #{limit}
select from litemall_retire_candidate where goods_id = #{goodsId} and deleted = 0 order by `day` desc limit 1
select from litemall_retire_candidate where goods_id = #{goodsId} and status = 'proposed' and deleted = 0 order by `day` desc limit 1
select from litemall_retire_candidate where status = 'approved' and execute_on is not null and execute_on <= #{today} and deleted = 0 order by execute_on asc, score desc, id asc
mapper.update: update litemall_retire_candidate set status = #{status}, execute_on = #{executeOn}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expect} and deleted = 0
